$comment: Ability combos inside a team, as a hint at a pick (app/src/core/model/kits.ts): which champions
belong to which list. Judgement, clear cases only - a champion that is absent is neutral.
Narrow on purpose (user, 15.11.2026): with wide lists nearly every second team had a wombo and
the tag stood at every engage champion. The combos count nothing in the percentage: measured on
207.968 games no combo wins measurably more than the lane strengths of its champions say
Champions by name as Data Dragon spells them; case and punctuation are ignored, the key counts
too. engageSkill: the skill an AoE engage holds them with, by loose name (lower case, letters
only); R where nothing is said.
The single source since 17.11.2026: the collector's export publishes this file to the data
branch as combos.json, the app downloads it with the numbers and keeps this copy only until the
first download is in. A new champion needs no release to get its tag.
